column1: # Every route whose reach includes a table with no tenant dimension, as
# ⭐ THE SET, NOT THE COUNT. A count is not an identity: one route added and one
# removed holds the number while the population changes underneath it. The
# published figures — 42 site-global writers, 33 of them on identity alone — are
# re-derived FROM these rows, so the file and the number cannot disagree.
# ⛔ `arm` says WHICH instrument answered. `walk` is the precise call walk and
# is what the published 42 counts; `module-reach` is the sound
# over-approximation used only where the walk reached no write at all, and a row
# carrying it is a reach, not a statement the route issues.
# Recorded by `SIGNOFF-REPAIR.7.1.1.1`. Refresh only with an adjudication:
# ⭐ `site authority` JOINED THE VOCABULARY at `SIGNOFF-REPAIR.7.1.2.1`. All TEN
# routes reaching a site-authority response had been classified `identity only`
# — the weakest label — because every one reaches `resolve_principal` and none
# of the other needles. Eight are mutating and appear below. The published
# figures moved 42 → 41 and 33 → 32 for ONE reason: `POST /v1/workflow-profiles`
# was repaired and left both sets; the other seven were already `module-reach`,
# so they were never in the precise count, only mislabelled in this file.
# ⭐ `POST /v1/policies` took the SAME step at `SIGNOFF-REPAIR.6.1.5.4`, for the
# same reason and with the same two consequences in one change: the policy
# LIBRARY became a `policy_register` site act, so the route left `identity only`
# AND left the precise walk, because its handler now delegates across a module
# boundary. The published figures move 26/17 → 25/16 — one movement, one cause,
# and a defect population going DOWN because the defect was fixed.
